decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-432 MODIFY recording the exact LED model, manufacturer, part number, color format, pad count, and package details.
The exact LED package selection does not change the requirement that charge status use the main-board SK6812 addressable LED chain on GPIO13.
Selecting the exact addressable LED model does not change the main-board power-source OR-ing method or source-selection behavior.
The LED model selection does not change standalone USB activation, LDO capacity, or the powered 3.3V scope.
The exact LED component does not change the main-board connector destinations, counts, or connector inventory.
The selected LED model does not change which rails are monitored, the monitor IC, or monitor placement.
The source identifies an LED part and does not alter the independent requirement for main-board local decoupling capacitors.
The exact LED model does not assign or revise any ESP32 GPIO.
The LED package selection does not change panel controls, touch inputs, button wiring, or their placement.
The addressable LED part selection is unrelated to I2C series-resistor population, purpose, and topology.
The source does not change interboard connector types, pinouts, signals, or matching-numbering requirements.
The main-board addressable LED model does not change the sensor-board input or output connector topology.
